scope: G3-1 paging storage; private A, shared K/all-A/S; coordinates u16, software slots usize

retirement.MmioTablePreparation.rollback: restore parents, full context ACK, return
retirement.retireEmptyUserPtSlots: detach all PT/PD/PDP, retain assigned retire_pending descriptors through one synchronous full-context ACK, then return all levels
retirement.detachAndReleaseUserPtStorage: detach user roots, context ACK, return; keep prepared replacement PDP
retirement.RamCacheKernelSplit.releaseReservation: unpublished only; published split belongs to kernel
retirement.scratch_store: never hardware published; AS exclusion ends borrowing
retirement.detachEmptyUserParents: detach only; caller retains assigned metadata until shared batch ACK
retirement.retryRetiredAddressSpaces: previous clear ACK; publication closed, all CPU/context users and AD loans ended before child and body returns
retirement.MmioWindow: serial boot ownership; mappings sealed before user dispatch and retained for device/firmware borrow lifetime
retirement.withdrawSharedDiscardRange: K/target A/shared VM: collect stable Descriptor borrows before writes; no PT/table/bank retirement; coordinates from pml4/pdp/pd after index removal; caller ACKs each AS before backing detach
retirement.writeUserPteAt: same occupancy/index update for slot and Descriptor writers; mandatory present implies user panic
retirement.populateUserPtPath: stage4b populate: ensurePageChecked distinguishes OutOfFreePages (ALLOC) from InvalidState (MAP); prepared tables are never retired here
